<!-- Machinery. Edit _content/home.yml instead of this file. -->

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helpers.R")
home <- read_data("home.yml")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
eyebrow(home$eyebrow)

cat("::: {.lede}\n\n", home$lede, "\n\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
emit(home$intro)

if (isTRUE(home$news$show)) {
  rule()
  eyebrow(home$news$heading %||% "Recent")
  news_block(n = home$news$count %||% 4)
  if (!is.null(home$news$more_link)) {
    cat('[[', home$news$more_link, '](news.qmd)]{.subtle}\n\n', sep = "")
  }
}

if (isTRUE(home$posts$show)) {
  rule()
  eyebrow(home$posts$heading %||% "From the blog")
  posts_block(n = home$posts$count %||% 3)
  if (!is.null(home$posts$more_link)) {
    cat('[[', home$posts$more_link, '](blog/index.qmd)]{.subtle}\n\n', sep = "")
  }
}

if (isTRUE(home$contact$show)) {
  rule()
  eyebrow(home$contact$heading %||% "Contact")
  contact_block(home$contact)
}
```
